verdict.rationale: Algolia's Agent Studio is a first-party AI capability inside the product. It connects an LLM to Algolia search and tools and manages the end-to-end workflow. However, it is framed as a builder for customer-facing agents (shopping assistants, summarizers, conversational search), not an assistant the Algolia user delegates their own work to. The agent skills and MCP server are external-agent integrations, not a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: an in-dashboard assistant that takes delegated tasks (e.g. configuring indices, rules or relevance), documentation of what it can do on the user's behalf, and hands-on corroboration.
